title: Order reservation consumer with pause/resume flow control
name: Inventory reservation consumer

questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this consumer limits the amount of work it takes on from the partition source? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
With the worker's settings, the source is paused at 64 in-flight orders. Reservations then complete one at a time. When is the source resumed?
choices: As soon as in-flight drops to 63
When in-flight drops to 16 or below
Only after every in-flight order has finished

questions.prompt: Offsets 10, 11 and 12 are in flight. Offset 12 finishes first, then 10. What has been committed after both complete (assuming 11 is still running)?
choices: Nothing new beyond what was committed before 10 finished, then 10

questions.prompt: An inventory reserve call throws for one order, and the dead-letter call for that order also rejects. What happens to the consumer?
choices: The order stays counted as in flight forever and the consumer slowly stalls
An unhandled rejection crashes the process
The order is released normally; its offset can be committed and capacity is freed
